dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA inpatient hospitalization receipt/billing subsystem - collection/payment information editing subprogram
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCGI0SUB02) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It handles inpatient hospitalization payment/collection record editing, calling ORCSNYUFTN to compute hospitalization fee records, selecting prior payment records, computing insurance combination sets, and building updated collection records with adjustment calculations.

notable_features: 18 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPSYUNOU.INC, CPSYUDAY.INC, COMMON-SPA, CPORCSHKNSET.INC, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with USING clause (called subprogram pattern)
OCCURS clauses for multi-occurrence payment records
REPLACING clause on COPY for field prefix substitution
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Complex arithmetic with COMPUTE for payment adjustment calculations
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 47776 bytes (1162 lines total). Japanese comments are garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system for Japan.
